name: Georgian Bay - Marr Lake Trail to Indian Head Cove and the Grotto
quote: 3km, 3.0 hours, difficulty varies from moderate to difficult
why: Circuit from Cyprus Lake out on the Georgian Bay Trail to the shore cliffs, Indian Head Cove, the Natural Arch and the Grotto, returning over shoreline boulders via Marr Lake.

name: Horse Lake Trail
why: Short trail along the east side of Horse Lake through marsh and woodland to a boulder beach on Georgian Bay, then back the same way or onward on the Bruce Trail.

name: Cyprus Lake Trail
why: Easier trail circling Cyprus Lake past charred stumps from early-1900s fires.

name: Halfway Log Dump
quote: The rugged shoreline is about a 1km hike from the parking lot
why: Short out-and-back from the Emmett Lake Road parking lot to a white cobble beach under sheer cliffs on the Bruce Trail.

name: Wild Garden Trail
why: Singing Sands trail through woods and dunes along Dorcas Bay to rare alvar habitat.

name: Bruce Trail to Little Dunks Bay Lookout
quote: Length: 0.8km (one way) Hiking Time: 10-15 minutes (one way)
why: Short, easy, wheelchair-accessible stretch of the Bruce Trail from the Visitor Centre through cedar forest to a platform overlooking Little Dunks Bay.

name: Bruce Trail Burnt Point Loop
quote: Length: 4.8km (round-trip from Visitor Centre) Hiking Time: 1.5 - 2 hours
why: Moderate, rocky side-trail loop off the Bruce Trail near the Visitor Centre through cedar forest to Georgian Bay views at Burnt Point.
